Title: Face ID first login enrollment
Objective: Verify biometric enrollment after fresh install
Steps: 1. Log in with credentials. 2. Accept Face ID prompt. 3. Kill app and relaunch.
Expected Result: Login completes via Face ID without password prompt

Title: Fingerprint failure falls back to password
Steps: 1. Trigger fingerprint login. 2. Fail scan 3 times.
Expected Result: Password prompt appears; no lockout loop

Title: Push notification opens order tracking
Objective: Verify deep link from push to tracking screen
Preconditions: Order in transit; push permission granted
Steps: 1. Background the app. 2. Send FCM push. 3. Tap notification.
Expected Result: App opens directly on tracking screen for the active order

Title: Push arrives while app backgrounded
Objective: Verify delivery with app in background
Expected Result: Notification delivered and visible in tray

Title: Queue prescription order in airplane mode
Objective: Verify offline order queuing and sync
Steps: 1. Enable airplane mode. 2. Place order. 3. Disable airplane mode.
Expected Result: Order queued offline and sent on reconnect without duplicates

Title: App usable at 15 percent battery with low power mode
Objective: Verify core flow under low power state
Preconditions: Battery at 15%; low power mode on
Expected Result: Flow completes; no killed background tasks

Title: Cold start under 3 seconds
Objective: Measure cold start on mid-tier device
Steps: 1. Kill app. 2. Launch from icon. 3. Time to interactive.

Title: Battery drain under 5 percent in 30 min
Steps: 1. Log battery. 2. Use app 30 min. 3. Compare.
Expected Result: Drain under 5 percent; no thermal warnings

Title: Crash report reaches Crashlytics with session data
Objective: Verify crash pipeline end to end
Steps: 1. Force crash. 2. Reopen app. 3. Check Crashlytics.
